meta.title: Savings Calculation: Verify that Save button is enabled when required fields are empty

plan.title: Savings Save Enabled on Empty Draft

steps.note: Navigate to the events list to locate an existing saved draft.
Open the first available saved draft for the savings check.
Open the Savings Calculation window while leaving all fields at their defaults.
Confirm the Savings Calculation window opened.
Verify Save is clickable even though no savings fields were selected.
